title: Santander UK plc deepens social housing lending footprint
summary: Santander UK has a long track record in social housing finance, with £7.8 billion of lending currently on its books supporting over 100 housing associations that own around 1.9 million homes across the UK. In late 2025 the bank agreed a £310 million refinancing package with Peabody, and separately participated in a £100 million funding deal for Stonewater alongside the Co-operative Bank, with Santander providing £50 million of that facility to support development and retrofit ambitions.
